core.title: Sustainable biobased packaging via integrated robotics/machine learning workflow for improved postharvest preservation
core.abstract: Reliance on petroleum-derived plastic packaging exacerbates environmental burdens and lacks intrinsic antimicrobial protection against food spoilage. While biobased materials offer a sustainable alternative, optimizing their formulations is hindered by vast component libraries, inefficient trial-and-error experimentation, and complex multiproperty requirements. Herein, we develop an integrated workflow combining robotic automation, machine learning predictions, density functional theory, and life cycle assessment to accelerate biobased packaging discovery. Leveraging data augmentation and ensemble modeling, we use a hierarchical neural network to predict ∼1 billion candidate formulations, balancing mechanical properties, optical transparency, and environmental footprint. The resulting biobased packaging demonstrates enhanced hydrostability, effective antimicrobial activity, and high barrier performance, significantly extending the shelf life of cucumbers and avocados. Last, we release a data-sharing platform featuring forward prediction, inverse design, and environmental impact functions to support community use. This integrative framework provides sustainable, antimicrobial packaging materials alternative to conventional plastic films.

core.title: The Human Side of Algorithmic Management: Exploring How Employees Negotiate AI-Driven Performance Monitoring, Autonomy, Privacy, and Workplace Trust
core.venue: Journal of Business Insight and Innovation
core.abstract: This study explores how employees experience and negotiates digital performance monitoring and algorithm-supported management in Pakistani workplaces, focusing on autonomy, privacy, fairness, and workplace trust. An exploratory qualitative design was employed, drawing on condensed summaries of semi-structured online interviews with 22 participants across diverse occupational and sectoral settings. Reflexive thematic analysis identified six interrelated themes: negotiating visibility, autonomy under metrics, privacy boundaries, supervisor-dependent fairness, organizational rules and occupational responsibilities, and employee voice and opportunities for challenge. Findings indicate that participants generally acknowledged monitoring benefits, including improved coordination, clearer performance expectations, and compliance support, while expressing concerns about inadequate contextual evaluation, behavioural pressures, unclear data practices, and limited opportunities to contest assessments. A central insight is the distinction between supportive managerial relationships and dependable organizational safeguards. Although supervisors may provide explanations and contextual consideration, employees also require transparent review authority, recognized correction procedures, clear privacy boundaries, and accessible channels for raising concerns. The study contributes an exploratory, employee-centred perspective on responsible algorithmic management and offers practical recommendations for more transparent, context-sensitive, and accountable workplace monitoring. core.title: AI-Enabled Intelligent Energy Optimisation for Smart Commercial Infrastructure Using IoT and Digital Twin Technologies
core.venue: International Journal of Innovative Technology and Exploring Engineering
core.abstract: Intelligent, sustainable management systems are needed to address rapid urbanisation and rising energy consumption in commercial facilities. Traditional Building Management Systems (BMS) are reactive, non-predictive, and non-automated, and they lack AI support for decision-making. This paper introduces EcoMind, an Internet of Things (IoT)- based intelligent energy optimisation framework for smart commercial infrastructures, supported by artificial intelligence. It is implemented in a cloud-native system that incorporates IoT telemetry simulation, predictive analytics, Digital Twin monitoring, sustainability assessment, and a telemetry-based conversational AI module. Anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, occupancy-aware intelligence, and rule-based optimisation mechanisms provide real-time analysis of HVAC, lighting, elevator, escalator, parking, and environmental sensor data. The definitions used for this study are as follows: occupancy utilisation: ratio of actual occupancy over maximum occupancy; total energy consumption: total energy consumed by HVAC, lighting, elevator, escalator and parking systems; anomaly deviation: dif erence between the current sensor reading and the historical normal behaviour; optimisation efficiency: ratio of reduction in energy consumption after applying optimisation strategies to the total energy consumption. The major innovation is using the Gemini APIs large language model to integrate live infrastructure telemetry data into a pipeline, enabling real-time reasoning without relying on static datasets. Experimental results show a decrease in total energy consumption of 18–22 parcent, improved response to anomaly detection and improved operational decision making. The results confirm that Digital Twin intelligence and Telemetry AI is a powerful complement that enhances scalability, adaptability, and sustainability in smart commercial infrastructure systems.

core.title: TGTV: An Interpretable Framework for UAV Fault Detection and Traceability via Spatiotemporal Graph Learning and Large Language Models
core.abstract: Fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles experience operating-condition transitions, asynchronous sensor sampling, and control-system compensation that can obscure fault signatures. Existing temporal detection methods have limited capacity to represent coupled faults across subsystems, track their evolution, and constrain language-model diagnoses with quantitative evidence. This paper proposes TGTV, an interpretable fault detection and traceability framework that integrates spatiotemporal graph learning with a large language model. A temporal convolutional network and a graph attention network with weighted fused adjacency extract multiscale temporal patterns and spatial dependencies among sensors. A hybrid temporal Transformer and variational autoencoder then evaluates window-level anomalies using prediction errors and reconstruction probabilities. Continuous-time Shapley attribution identifies critical sensors and high-contribution intervals while preserving the temporal continuity of fault evolution. A structured evidence package combines detection results, graph relationships, temporal attribution, sensor attribution, and operating context. An evidence-constrained diagnosis protocol uses this package to generate flight-level conclusions with traceable evidence identifiers. Cross-flight holdout experiments on the public ALFA fixed-wing flight dataset yield a window-level area under the precision-recall curve of 0.976, accuracy of 0.973, recall of 0.902, and F1 score of 0.920. Flight-level fault diagnosis achieves recall of 0.943 and an F1 score of 0.944. These results demonstrate accurate anomaly detection and quantitatively supported fault-tracing cues, providing a basis for interpretable post-flight fault review and analysis.

core.abstract: يشهد التعليم المعماري تحولًا متسارعًا نتيجة التطورات المتلاحقة في تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي، والتي أصبحت تلعب دورًا محوريًا في دعم عمليات التصميم، وتحليل البدائل، وتقييم الأداء، وتوليد الحلول الإبداعية داخل استوديو التصميم المعماري. وقد أسهم التطور الكبير في أدوات مثل التصميم التوليدي (Generative Design)، والنماذج اللغوية الكبيرة (Large Language Models)، وتقنيات توليد الصور بالذكاء الاصطناعي في إعادة تشكيل طبيعة العملية التصميمية، مما فرض تحديات جديدة على مؤسسات التعليم المعماري لإعادة النظر في مناهجها وأساليب تدريسها بما يتماشى مع متطلبات التحول الرقمي والثورة الصناعية الرابعة (UNESCO, 2023؛ Holmes et al., 2022؛ Jang et al., 2025). تهدف هذه الدراسة إلى تطوير إطار تعليمي مقترح لتوظيف تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي في تنمية مهارات طلبة العمارة داخل مقررات التصميم المعماري، وذلك من خلال تحليل الأدبيات الحديثة والدراسات المنشورة خلال الفترة (2021–2026)، واستخلاص أفضل الممارسات العالمية في دمج الذكاء الاصطناعي في التعليم المعماري (Oxman, 2021؛ Stanimirovic et al., 2026). كما تعتمد الدراسة على المنهج الوصفي التحليلي القائم على مراجعة وتحليل الأدبيات العلمية الحديثة، ومقارنة الاتجاهات البحثية المعاصرة، وتحليل العلاقة بين أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي ومراحل العملية التصميمية، وصولًا إلى بناء إطار تعليمي متكامل يحدد مكونات البيئة التعليمية، وأدوار كل من عضو هيئة التدريس والطالب، وأدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي، واستراتيجيات التدريس، وآليات التقويم (Holmes et al., 2022؛ UNESCO, 2023). وتشير نتائج الدراسة إلى أن دمج الذكاء الاصطناعي في التعليم المعماري لا ينبغي أن يقتصر على الاستخدام التقني للأدوات الرقمية، بل يجب أن يتم ضمن إطار تربوي منظم يحقق التوازن بين تعزيز التفكير التصميمي والإبداع البشري، والاستفادة من القدرات التحليلية والتوليدية للذكاء الاصطناعي. كما يؤكد الإطار المقترح على أهمية الدمج التدريجي للذكاء الاصطناعي عبر مراحل التصميم المختلفة، مع وضع معايير واضحة للتقويم، وتعزيز الجوانب الأخلاقية المتعلقة بالاستخدام المسؤول لهذه التقنيات (Jabi, 2023؛ UNESCO, 2023).وتسهم هذه الدراسة في تقديم إطار علمي يمكن أن تستفيد منه كليات الهندسة والعمارة في تطوير مناهج التصميم المعماري، بما يتوافق مع الاتجاهات العالمية الحديثة في التعليم الرقمي والذكاء الاصطناعي(Oxman, 2021؛ Jang et al., 2025).

papers.title: Sustainable biobased packaging via integrated robotics/machine learning workflow for improved postharvest preservation
papers.abstract: Reliance on petroleum-derived plastic packaging exacerbates environmental burdens and lacks intrinsic antimicrobial protection against food spoilage. While biobased materials offer a sustainable alternative, optimizing their formulations is hindered by vast component libraries, inefficient trial-and-error experimentation, and complex multiproperty requirements. Herein, we develop an integrated workflow combining robotic automation, machine learning predictions, density functional theory, and life cycle assessment to accelerate biobased packaging discovery. Leveraging data augmentation and ensemble modeling, we use a hierarchical neural network to predict ∼1 billion candidate formulations, balancing mechanical properties, optical transparency, and environmental footprint. The resulting biobased packaging demonstrates enhanced hydrostability, effective antimicrobial activity, and high barrier performance, significantly extending the shelf life of cucumbers and avocados. Last, we release a data-sharing platform featuring forward prediction, inverse design, and environmental impact functions to support community use. This integrative framework provides sustainable, antimicrobial packaging materials alternative to conventional plastic films.

papers.title: The Human Side of Algorithmic Management: Exploring How Employees Negotiate AI-Driven Performance Monitoring, Autonomy, Privacy, and Workplace Trust
papers.venue: Journal of Business Insight and Innovation
papers.abstract: This study explores how employees experience and negotiates digital performance monitoring and algorithm-supported management in Pakistani workplaces, focusing on autonomy, privacy, fairness, and workplace trust. An exploratory qualitative design was employed, drawing on condensed summaries of semi-structured online interviews with 22 participants across diverse occupational and sectoral settings. Reflexive thematic analysis identified six interrelated themes: negotiating visibility, autonomy under metrics, privacy boundaries, supervisor-dependent fairness, organizational rules and occupational responsibilities, and employee voice and opportunities for challenge. Findings indicate that participants generally acknowledged monitoring benefits, including improved coordination, clearer performance expectations, and compliance support, while expressing concerns about inadequate contextual evaluation, behavioural pressures, unclear data practices, and limited opportunities to contest assessments. A central insight is the distinction between supportive managerial relationships and dependable organizational safeguards. Although supervisors may provide explanations and contextual consideration, employees also require transparent review authority, recognized correction procedures, clear privacy boundaries, and accessible channels for raising concerns. The study contributes an exploratory, employee-centred perspective on responsible algorithmic management and offers practical recommendations for more transparent, context-sensitive, and accountable workplace monitoring. papers.title: AI-Enabled Intelligent Energy Optimisation for Smart Commercial Infrastructure Using IoT and Digital Twin Technologies
papers.venue: International Journal of Innovative Technology and Exploring Engineering
papers.abstract: Intelligent, sustainable management systems are needed to address rapid urbanisation and rising energy consumption in commercial facilities. Traditional Building Management Systems (BMS) are reactive, non-predictive, and non-automated, and they lack AI support for decision-making. This paper introduces EcoMind, an Internet of Things (IoT)- based intelligent energy optimisation framework for smart commercial infrastructures, supported by artificial intelligence. It is implemented in a cloud-native system that incorporates IoT telemetry simulation, predictive analytics, Digital Twin monitoring, sustainability assessment, and a telemetry-based conversational AI module. Anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, occupancy-aware intelligence, and rule-based optimisation mechanisms provide real-time analysis of HVAC, lighting, elevator, escalator, parking, and environmental sensor data. The definitions used for this study are as follows: occupancy utilisation: ratio of actual occupancy over maximum occupancy; total energy consumption: total energy consumed by HVAC, lighting, elevator, escalator and parking systems; anomaly deviation: dif erence between the current sensor reading and the historical normal behaviour; optimisation efficiency: ratio of reduction in energy consumption after applying optimisation strategies to the total energy consumption. The major innovation is using the Gemini APIs large language model to integrate live infrastructure telemetry data into a pipeline, enabling real-time reasoning without relying on static datasets. Experimental results show a decrease in total energy consumption of 18–22 parcent, improved response to anomaly detection and improved operational decision making. The results confirm that Digital Twin intelligence and Telemetry AI is a powerful complement that enhances scalability, adaptability, and sustainability in smart commercial infrastructure systems.

papers.title: TGTV: An Interpretable Framework for UAV Fault Detection and Traceability via Spatiotemporal Graph Learning and Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles experience operating-condition transitions, asynchronous sensor sampling, and control-system compensation that can obscure fault signatures. Existing temporal detection methods have limited capacity to represent coupled faults across subsystems, track their evolution, and constrain language-model diagnoses with quantitative evidence. This paper proposes TGTV, an interpretable fault detection and traceability framework that integrates spatiotemporal graph learning with a large language model. A temporal convolutional network and a graph attention network with weighted fused adjacency extract multiscale temporal patterns and spatial dependencies among sensors. A hybrid temporal Transformer and variational autoencoder then evaluates window-level anomalies using prediction errors and reconstruction probabilities. Continuous-time Shapley attribution identifies critical sensors and high-contribution intervals while preserving the temporal continuity of fault evolution. A structured evidence package combines detection results, graph relationships, temporal attribution, sensor attribution, and operating context. An evidence-constrained diagnosis protocol uses this package to generate flight-level conclusions with traceable evidence identifiers. Cross-flight holdout experiments on the public ALFA fixed-wing flight dataset yield a window-level area under the precision-recall curve of 0.976, accuracy of 0.973, recall of 0.902, and F1 score of 0.920. Flight-level fault diagnosis achieves recall of 0.943 and an F1 score of 0.944. These results demonstrate accurate anomaly detection and quantitatively supported fault-tracing cues, providing a basis for interpretable post-flight fault review and analysis.

papers.title: توظيف الذكاء الاصطناعي في تطوير مهارات التصميم المعماري: نحو إطار تعليمي مقترح لمقررات التصميم المعماري
papers.abstract: يشهد التعليم المعماري تحولًا متسارعًا نتيجة التطورات المتلاحقة في تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي، والتي أصبحت تلعب دورًا محوريًا في دعم عمليات التصميم، وتحليل البدائل، وتقييم الأداء، وتوليد الحلول الإبداعية داخل استوديو التصميم المعماري. وقد أسهم التطور الكبير في أدوات مثل التصميم التوليدي (Generative Design)، والنماذج اللغوية الكبيرة (Large Language Models)، وتقنيات توليد الصور بالذكاء الاصطناعي في إعادة تشكيل طبيعة العملية التصميمية، مما فرض تحديات جديدة على مؤسسات التعليم المعماري لإعادة النظر في مناهجها وأساليب تدريسها بما يتماشى مع متطلبات التحول الرقمي والثورة الصناعية الرابعة (UNESCO, 2023؛ Holmes et al., 2022؛ Jang et al., 2025). تهدف هذه الدراسة إلى تطوير إطار تعليمي مقترح لتوظيف تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي في تنمية مهارات طلبة العمارة داخل مقررات التصميم المعماري، وذلك من خلال تحليل الأدبيات الحديثة والدراسات المنشورة خلال الفترة (2021–2026)، واستخلاص أفضل الممارسات العالمية في دمج الذكاء الاصطناعي في التعليم المعماري (Oxman, 2021؛ Stanimirovic et al., 2026). كما تعتمد الدراسة على المنهج الوصفي التحليلي القائم على مراجعة وتحليل الأدبيات العلمية الحديثة، ومقارنة الاتجاهات البحثية المعاصرة، وتحليل العلاقة بين أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي ومراحل العملية التصميمية، وصولًا إلى بناء إطار تعليمي متكامل يحدد مكونات البيئة التعليمية، وأدوار كل من عضو هيئة التدريس والطالب، وأدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي، واستراتيجيات التدريس، وآليات التقويم (Holmes et al., 2022؛ UNESCO, 2023). وتشير نتائج الدراسة إلى أن دمج الذكاء الاصطناعي في التعليم المعماري لا ينبغي أن يقتصر على الاستخدام التقني للأدوات الرقمية، بل يجب أن يتم ضمن إطار تربوي منظم يحقق التوازن بين تعزيز التفكير التصميمي والإبداع البشري، والاستفادة من القدرات التحليلية والتوليدية للذكاء الاصطناعي. كما يؤكد الإطار المقترح على أهمية الدمج التدريجي للذكاء الاصطناعي عبر مراحل التصميم المختلفة، مع وضع معايير واضحة للتقويم، وتعزيز الجوانب الأخلاقية المتعلقة بالاستخدام المسؤول لهذه التقنيات (Jabi, 2023؛ UNESCO, 2023).وتسهم هذه الدراسة في تقديم إطار علمي يمكن أن تستفيد منه كليات الهندسة والعمارة في تطوير مناهج التصميم المعماري، بما يتوافق مع الاتجاهات العالمية الحديثة في التعليم الرقمي والذكاء الاصطناعي(Oxman, 2021؛ Jang et al., 2025).
